A note on a torn sheet of chart paper.

## The Text

```text
If you're reading this you found the drawer,
so you're one of mine. Good.

The tide tables in the office are wrong.
Somebody changed them. Low water at the
Teeth is two hours later than they say,
and two boats have gone onto the rocks
trusting the printed times.

I've marked the real ones on the back.

Don't tell the harbourmaster. Don't
tell anyone who drinks at the Anchor.
Burn this when you've learned it.

        — M.
```
